releaseIdentity.versionAuthority: This distribution manifest owns the 0.x preview version. Component packages, crates, services, and hs-machine selectors retain independent versions.
releaseIdentity.immutableArtifactRule: A published version is never overwritten, reinterpreted, or reused. Corrections receive a new distribution version.

authority.rule: The manifest is the machine-readable candidate boundary. The consumer contract explains it; neither file authorizes publication while releaseDecision.readyToPublish is false.

capabilities: Parse, validate, format, and compile HoloScript source through the pinned npm core and CLI components.
Compile the cumulative, fail-closed native machine subset through hs-machine-v32 with holoscriptc.
Validate the portable parser and type-checker path through holoscript-wasm.
Run local parse, validation, and native compilation without a hosted service or private workspace clone.
Use hosted MCP, Absorb, and Studio as optional companions with independent service versions.
consumerPromises: The distribution version identifies one immutable component and artifact set.
Local compile paths require no HoloScript service credential.
Unsupported native syntax and unsafe ownership or provenance states fail closed.
Every component pin, artifact digest, and declared service compatibility result is recorded before publication.

knownLimits: 0.1.0 is an unstable preview, not a stable API, production-readiness, or drop-in compatibility claim.
The native compiler supports the cumulative hs-machine-v0 through hs-machine-v32 subset, not every parser or library surface in the wider TypeScript ecosystem.
The first native binary target is win32-x64; Linux, macOS, ARM64, and cross-compilation artifacts are deferred until separately declared and proven.
HoloScript is not yet self-hosting, and bootstrap compiler/runtime implementations still include Rust and TypeScript.
Hosted MCP, Absorb, and Studio have independent versions and no preview SLA; loss of those services must not break local compilation.
PyPI packages and existing npm package versions are legacy component lines and are not the HoloScript Systems Toolchain 0.1.0 identity.

rails.coldProbe: Import the bundled WASM parser/type-checker and run the declared conformance corpus.

rails.compatibilityProbe: GET https://mcp.holoscript.net/health and compile the release example through the declared public tool surface.
GET https://absorb.holoscript.net/health and run a bounded sourceFiles Absorb probe.
Read the declared Studio health endpoint and confirm the preview install path remains optional.

rails.reason: The existing PyPI line remains independently versioned and is not part of the first systems-toolchain distribution.

coldConsumerRequirements: No founder-local path, GOLD vault, private .env file, or HoloScript service credential.
Node.js 20 or later and a supported win32-x64 host for the first native binary.
Network access only for installation; local parse, validate, and compile remain offline-capable after installation.

compatibilityPolicy.minorReleaseRule: A 0.x minor release may make breaking language, CLI, manifest, or ABI changes only with migration notes and an explicit changed-boundary list.
compatibilityPolicy.patchReleaseRule: A patch release must not intentionally break a documented supported surface.
compatibilityPolicy.deprecationRule: When safety permits, retain deprecated behavior for at least one preview minor release; unsafe behavior may be removed immediately with a security migration note.
compatibilityPolicy.machineContractRule: An hs-machine-vN successor never changes the public distribution version by itself.
compatibilityPolicy.componentPinRule: Changing any required component pin or artifact content requires a new distribution version and fresh parity receipts.

supportContract.serviceLevel: best-effort preview; no uptime or response-time SLA
supported: Reproducing documented install, parse, validate, and compile failures on the declared host and pinned artifacts.
Security reports, deterministic artifact mismatches, and fail-closed compiler regressions.
unsupported: Undeclared host targets, private plugins, founder-local services, and compatibility with unpinned component versions.
Stable-API, production-readiness, or drop-in replacement guarantees.

rollbackContract.npm: Never overwrite or reuse a published version. Move the preview dist-tag to the last verified release; if 0.1.0 is the first and is defective, remove the preview tag and publish the correction as 0.1.1 or later.
rollbackContract.nativeArtifacts: Retain immutable checksums, mark a defective artifact withdrawn, and restore the last verified artifact link. If no prior preview exists, withhold the install link until a corrected version is available.
rollbackContract.services: Rollback hosted companions independently to their prior deployment. Service loss cannot invalidate the offline compiler artifact or require a distribution-version rewrite.
rollbackContract.source: Revert the faulty source commit through a normal commit, preserve the failed receipt, and publish migration or recovery notes with the corrected candidate.

securityContract.credentialBoundary: Local install, parse, validate, and compile require no HoloScript credential. Hosted companion credentials are caller-owned and never bundled.
requiredArtifactChecks: Inspect npm pack contents and native archive contents against explicit allowlists.
Scan packed artifacts for secrets, wallet material, private paths, auth caches, and source maps not intended for consumers.
Run HS010 lexical-firewall and fail-closed native diagnostics on the exact candidate artifacts.
Record SHA-256 digests for every immutable distribution artifact.

requiredProof: Every distribution rail embeds this manifest schema, distribution ID, version, source commit, and artifact digest set.
The npm, native, and WASM cold probes consume the same conformance corpus and report the same minimum machine contract.
Hosted companions report compatibility with the distribution manifest but retain their own SemVer.

gates.remaining: Run the cumulative corpus through the exact packed npm, native, and WASM candidate artifacts.
Build the named distribution artifacts and emit their source-commit and SHA-256 set.
Create and pack @holoscript/systems@0.1.0, then run the repo-less cold probe.
PyPI is explicitly excluded from this distribution identity.
Prove the new meta-package dependency closure and immutable artifact versions.
Close the declared candidate consumption or public-API-canary gaps.
Add every missing required package steward record.
Inspect and secret-scan the exact npm, native, and WASM candidate artifacts.
Record release-date compatibility probes and rollback readback for every optional hosted companion.
Build all distribution rails and compare embedded identity, conformance, commit, and digest receipts.

releaseDecision.authorizationRule: Only a validated manifest with every required gate at pass may authorize a 0.1.0 publish, tag, or distribution claim.
